elements.element: Renewal is automatic for successive 12-month periods (preferred alternative B)
elements.evidence: "will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months" (both paragraphs, incl. Attachment changed from six (6) months)

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless IBM gives thirty (30) days written notice ... of its intent to terminate this Agreement"

elements.element: Vendor must send a reminder 60 days before renewal
elements.evidence: No reminder mechanic anywhere; clause only addresses notices of intent to terminate.

elements.element: Price increases on renewal capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: Only "successive periods under the same terms and conditions, unless otherwise agreed in writing" — no cap on increases.

elements.element: Alternative: renewal only by mutual written agreement
elements.evidence: Renewal remains automatic: "will automatically be renewed".
"This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months"

elements.element: Customer non-renewal notice window no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: "IBM gives thirty (30) days written notice" — 30 days is within the 60-day ceiling.
Clause renews "under the same terms and conditions, unless otherwise agreed in writing by both Parties" with no percentage limit on increases.

reasons: The locked target is preferred, but two preferred elements are absent: there is no Vendor obligation to send a renewal reminder 60 days before each renewal, and there is no cap on renewal price increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

Fallback is also incomplete: although the Customer non-renewal window is now 30 days (within the 60-day ceiling) and renewal is automatic, no ≤5% limit on price increases was inserted, so neither bargain is fully satisfied.

The edits themselves are surgical and well targeted — only the notice mechanic and the Attachment's six-month renewal period were changed, MSL's own notice period was deliberately left intact, and no undefined terms or dangling mechanics were introduced.

To reach the locked preferred level, add a short insertion such as: Vendor shall notify IBM in writing not less than sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal, and any price increase on renewal shall not exceed the lesser of CPI or three percent (3%).
